customManagers.description: Release tool versions, pinned next to a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment (GitHub release binaries: cosign in release.yml, syft, grype, crane in install-release-tools.sh, yq in install-yq.sh). `extractVersion` strips the `v` of tags whose pin has none. The pinned SHA-256 checksums are NOT updated, see the packageRules. (helm and kind are pinned in `with: version:` of setup-helm / kind-action, which the github-actions manager reads itself.)
Cargo tools installed as `tool: name@x.y.z[,…]` by taiki-e/install-action, and by `cargo install --locked` in the docs
ziglang in the docs (the hash-pinned .github/requirements/ziglang.txt is the pip_requirements manager)
BuildKit image of docker/setup-buildx-action: the version in the comment above the digest-only reference, and the index digest
kind node images, pinned by tag and index digest (CI matrix and the commands in the docs)

packageRules.description: The chart's image reference (tag from appVersion, digest empty) is released by this project, never pinned or bumped by Renovate
Runner image (`runs-on: ubuntu-24.04`): changing it is a deliberate decision, never a Renovate pull request
Cargo: group minor and patch updates; majors come as separate PRs
GitHub Actions: group minor and patch updates (SHA pins and the version comments are kept)

No cosign major by Renovate: v3 changes the signature format, and docs/security.md and docs/development.md document the releases as signed with cosign v2 in the legacy format; moving to v3 is a deliberate decision
Release tooling: what builds, scans and signs the release (minor and patch in one PR; majors separately)
CI tooling: helm and the cargo checks (minor and patch in one PR; majors separately)
kind and its node images move together, in one PR
prBodyNotes: kind node images are published with a kind release: take the node image digests from the release notes of the kind version pinned in this PR (https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kind/releases) and compare them with the digests Renovate wrote. If the release has no image for a pinned patch version, do not merge the image update.

packageRules.description: A new Kubernetes minor is a decision about the test matrix (ci.yml, docs/development.md), made by hand; Renovate only moves the patch of a pinned minor. separateMultipleMinor gives every minor its own bucket: without it Renovate picks the highest release (a newer minor), the rule below disables that, and the patch of the pinned minor is never proposed. (Not separateMinorPatch: it would make every patch its own PR.)
See the rule above: the newer-minor bucket of kindest/node stays disabled, the patch bucket of the pinned minor stays in the kind group
Pinned tool binaries whose SHA-256 is pinned next to the version: Renovate cannot recompute the checksum
prBodyNotes: **Update the matching SHA-256 in this PR before merging**: `SYFT_SHA256` / `GRYPE_SHA256` / `CRANE_SHA256` in `.github/scripts/install-release-tools.sh`, `YQ_SHA256` in `.github/scripts/install-yq.sh`. Take it from the checksums file of the new upstream release (the `linux_amd64` / `Linux_x86_64` archive; see docs/development.md, "Pinned tools and Renovate"). A version bump without it fails closed (`sha256sum --check`): the `release-pins` and `release-scripts` CI jobs of this PR fail with the variable named.

packageRules.description: BuildKit: digest of the image index
prBodyNotes: The BuildKit reference is pinned by the digest of the image index (`docker/setup-buildx-action` `driver-opts`), in `ci.yml` and `release.yml`; both must be updated together, with the version in the comment above them.
